lines.zh: 我踩在熔岩上，像踩草地。
lines.en: I walk lava like meadow grass.
My hooves do not fear the heat.
I keep to the lava lake's rim.
Ash falls on my back and slides off.
Each step rings a little fire.
I cannot go near the water.
I know this heat well.
My shadow shows in the lava.
I duck under a charred branch.
I walk steady, on fire below.
My red coat glows in the dark.
I skirt the vent mouth.
There is warm air here. I follow it.

lines.zh: 我四蹄落地，火苗跳了一下。
lines.en: My hooves land and the flames leap.
Only I can walk this road.
I climb along the rock ridge.

lines.zh: 我站在火边，什么都不怕。
lines.en: I stand by the fire without fear.
The heat dries my coat.
I lift my nose and sniff.
I am used to the smell of sulfur.
I do not go to the water side.
I chew a stalk of charred grass.
Smoke still rises from my hooves.
I wait for the herd to pass.
Nothing else lives on this ground.
I stand and fire curls around my legs.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾巴，火星飞了。
lines.en: I swish my tail and sparks fly.
The cracks in my antlers are old.
I listen to the lava moving.
Even the night here is hot.
I need no shade.
Only the fire makes any sound.
You should not stand here.
You cannot keep your footing on the obsidian.
I look at you from within the fire.
You are not afraid of heat?
The lava crust is firm under my hooves.

lines.zh: 这里的空气会烧你的肺。
lines.en: The air here will burn your lungs.

lines.zh: 你身后就是流下来的岩浆。
lines.en: The flowing lava is right behind you.

lines.zh: 我的角对着你，只是习惯。
lines.en: My antlers point your way. Only habit.

lines.zh: 你站在熔岩边上，鞋底快化了。
lines.en: You stand at the lava edge and your soles are melting.
I do not like that smell.
Go now, while you can.
I am here. You need not fear.
I step back and my hooves slip.
Lava underfoot feels like mud to me.
I shake my head to clear it.
Blood hits hot stone and hisses.

lines.zh: 热气灌进我的鼻子，很难受。
lines.en: Hot air pours into my nose and it hurts.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子裂了一道，还烫。
lines.en: A crack splits my hoof, and it still burns.
I tilted, and righted myself.
Someone struck my back.
My breath comes out hotter.

lines.zh: 我的皮毛冒着烟，没被点着。
lines.en: My hide smokes but will not catch.
What grass is that?
It smells edible.
You hold it too far away.

lines.zh: 我踩在熔岩上，像踩实地。
lines.en: I walk the lava as if it were solid.
Set it on the stone.
I lean in and sniff first.
Dry grass scorches the moment it touches the fire.
Do not shake, or it falls in the fire.

lines.zh: 焦过的茎叶，才嚼得下去。
lines.en: Only scorched stems are worth chewing.
Have you more?

lines.zh: 熔岩对我来说就是地面。
lines.en: To me, lava is just ground.
A little more and I will follow.
This thing is smoking.
I chew slowly.
On the ground is fine.
I do not snatch.
You bumped me. I am hot.

lines.zh: 熔岩对我来说，就是平地。
lines.en: Lava is just flat ground to me.
The heat wave pushed you.
My coat runs hotter than fire.
Lava underfoot feels like solid ground.
A wave of heat rolls off my back at you.
Get close and I will bake you.
I do not mind. You will.
This ledge is too narrow.
You go first.
One touch of antlers and it is settled.
We walk a circle by the fire.
Its coat is darker than mine.
Neither of us fears the burn.
The young will be born in a rock crevice.
It lowers its head first, and then I do.
The heat wraps us together.

lines.zh: 她用角在我的角上敲了一下。
lines.en: She taps her antler against mine.
There are no other elk here.
When we go, we go together.
I picked this up from the ground.
It is hot. I do not care.
This stone is a good one.

lines.zh: 我把烫的石头含在嘴里。
lines.en: I hold the hot stone in my mouth.
Not grass. Not interested.
I kicked it aside.
This smells strange.

lines.zh: 这东西在熔岩里烧得通红。
lines.en: Something burns red in the lava.
What you dropped, I don't plan to return.
It is smoking in my mouth.
Something is moving. Not you.
I saw it.
It stepped too near the fire.

lines.zh: 我踏过一块冷却的黑岩。
lines.en: I step across a patch of cooled black rock.
My antler tips point that way.
I walk on the lava's surface.
This time I go first.

lines.zh: 熔岩的光把它的影子拉长。
lines.en: The lava light stretches its shadow long.
The firelight does not reach it.
I cross a hot rock.
I circle around the fire.
It backs to the rock wall.
There is no other way.

lines.zh: 我的鹿角在热风里发亮。
lines.en: My antlers gleam in the hot wind.
Sparks fly from my hooves.
It looks up at me.
I am taller than it.
My antlers are already low.

lines.zh: 熔岩上面，我的蹄子不烫。
lines.en: Lava doesn't burn these hooves.
It will move first.
Lava under my hooves is like flat ground.
The antlers go through its chest.
I wrench my head and toss it up.
My hooves come down.
It is knocked to the fire's edge.
The fire leaps up.
I step back and shake my antlers.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踏在它胸口上。
lines.en: My hoof comes down on its chest.
I hook it into a rock crevice with my antler.
It has stopped moving.
I rise out of the lava.
This fire suits me.
Heat comes up through my feet.
I step onto rock.
The sulfur smell is strong.
First I look for a way.
There is no grass here.
There is fire far off, and near.
I shake the lava off.
My hooves glow.
Fire does nothing to me but warm.
I hit the rock and a bone knocks.
Water touches me and I stiffen all over.
The blast wave flips me over.

lines.zh: 熔岩上的红麋鹿，肩上中了一箭。
lines.en: A red elk on lava, arrow in its shoulder.
This cold force. I dislike it.
Too little grass here. I am hungry.
Lightning strikes and my legs give.
No rock below, and no fire.
